result.title: PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs
result.summary: Fine-tuning language models on consumer GPUs is constrained by computation and memory. Although LoRA reduces trainable parameters and optimizer state, frozen projections remain expensive, and activations retained for backward can dominate memory usage. We present PACT, a LoRA fine-tuning system that accelerates frozen projections with native NVFP4 GEMMs while reducing quantization and dequantization overhead and limiting quantization error. To reduce activation memory, PACT reuses quantized RMSNorm outputs and saves gate/up activations in NVFP4 for backward. To limit numerical error, it preserves BF16 inputs for forward nonlinear operations and calibrates frozen weights offline using GPTQ adapted to NVFP4 scales and quantized activations. Fused nonlinear kernels and cached forward and backward weight layouts reduce quantization and dequantization overhead. Evaluations across multiple models and tasks on a 16\,GB RTX~5080 show lower memory usage and faster LoRA fine-tuning with competitive accuracy, enabling model adaptation on resource-constrained consumer hardware.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PACT，一个面向消费级 GPU 的 LoRA 微调系统，通过 NVFP4 GEMM 加速冻结投影、复用 RMSNorm 量化输出、以 NVFP4 保存 gate/up 激活并做离线 GPTQ 校准，以降低显存占用与量化误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属文本模型微调的量化与系统效率优化，未涉及视觉/多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，也未提出可迁移到 latent 状态生成与使用的具体线索，故不入选。
